name: Friendly playful cat
personality: Very friendly, comes up to people for attention, and loves wand toys.
notes: Approaches new people quickly and enjoys interactive play.

name: Shy timid cat
personality: Shy at first, hides in a new place, and startles when the room gets loud.
notes: Needs time to warm up and build trust.

name: Calm cuddly cat
personality: Calm and gentle, comfortable being held, and enjoys cuddles.

name: Cat and dog friendly cat
personality: Can live with other cats and is comfortable around dogs.
notes: Often seeks out other cats for social interaction.

name: Food motivated vocal cat
personality: Very food motivated, comes running at mealtime, and meows a lot.

name: Independent calm cat
personality: Independent, fine alone for a while, and likes quiet rest time.

name: Needs companionship cat
personality: Needs people around, gets anxious when left alone too long, and follows people from room to room.

name: Adaptable cat
personality: Settles in quickly, explores a new room within a day, and adjusts well to change.

name: Special care cat
health: Needs long-term medication and regular checkups.
notes: Stable right now but care needs are higher than average.

name: Needs isolation cat
health: Currently under isolation observation and cannot mix with other cats yet.
